import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyMayerVietorisConsumer

/-! Cohomology of a disjoint two-set cover.

The overlap of a disjoint cover is empty.  Its singular cochain groups vanish,
so Mayer--Vietoris identifies ambient cohomology with the biproduct of the two
pieces.  This is the finite-discrete product calculation used by the circle
cover.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/- The empty space has no singular simplices, hence no cochains. -/
theorem integralSingularCohomology_empty_eq_zero (Y : TopCat) (n : ℕ)
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (∅ : Set Y)) n) : c = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := singularCohomologyClass_surjective (TopCat.of (∅ : Set Y)) n c
  have hφ : φ.1 = 0 := by
    apply integralSingularCochain_ext
    intro σ
    exfalso
    exact isEmptyElim ((TopCat.of (∅ : Set Y)).toSSetObjEquiv
      (op ⦋n⦌) σ (stdSimplex.vertex 0))
  have hφ' : φ = 0 := Subtype.ext hφ
  rw [hφ']
  simp

theorem singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction_isIso_of_disjoint
    (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (hdisj : Disjoint U V) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction X U V n) := by
  let S := singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V n
  have heq : (U ∩ V : Set X) = ∅ := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact (hdisj.le_bot ⟨hx.1, hx.2⟩).elim
    · intro hx
      simp at hx
  have hinter (k : ℕ) :
      ∀ c : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) k, c = 0 := by
    rw [heq]
    exact integralSingularCohomology_empty_eq_zero X k
  have hdiff : singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference X U V n = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact hinter n _
  have hconn (k : ℕ) :
      singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcover k = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rw [hinter k x]
    simp
  letI : Epi S.f :=
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_consumer X U V hU hV hcover n).epi_f hdiff
  letI : Mono S.f := by
    cases n with
    | zero => exact singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction_mono_zero X U V hU hV hcover
    | succ n =>
      exact (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_union X U V hU hV hcover n).mono_g
        (hconn n)
  exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi S.f

/-- The fiber of the second projection over a point is the first factor. -/
def discreteProductFiberHomeomorph (X D : TopCat) (d : D) :
    ({p | p.2 = d} : Set (X × D)) ≃ₜ X where
  toFun p := p.1.1
  invFun x := ⟨(x, d), rfl⟩
  left_inv p := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl p.property.symm)
  right_inv _ := rfl
  continuous_toFun := continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val
  continuous_invFun := (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).subtype_mk _

/-- A section of the second projection at a specified point of the factor. -/
def discreteProductSection (X D : TopCat) (d : D) : X ⟶ TopCat.of (X × D) :=
  TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun x => (x, d), continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const⟩

def discreteProductProjection (X D : TopCat) : TopCat.of (X × D) ⟶ X :=
  TopCat.ofHom ⟨Prod.fst, continuous_fst⟩

def discreteProductFiberInclusion (X D : TopCat) (d : D) :
    TopCat.of ({p | p.2 = d} : Set (X × D)) ⟶ TopCat.of (X × D) :=
  TopCat.ofHom ⟨(fun p => p.1), continuous_subtype_val⟩

@[simp]
theorem discreteProductSection_projection (X D : TopCat) (d : D) :
    discreteProductSection X D d ≫ discreteProductProjection X D = 𝟙 X := by
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem discreteProductFiberInclusion_projection (X D : TopCat) (d : D) :
    discreteProductFiberInclusion X D d ≫ discreteProductProjection X D =
      TopCat.ofHom ⟨(fun p => p.1.1), continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩ := by
  rfl

/-- The restriction isomorphism for a product with a discrete two-point space. -/
def discreteProductCohomologyIso (X D : TopCat) [DiscreteTopology D]
    (d₀ d₁ : D) (hne : d₀ ≠ d₁) (hD : ∀ d : D, d = d₀ ∨ d = d₁) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × D)) n ≅
      IntegralSingularCohomology X n ⊞ IntegralSingularCohomology X n := by
  let U : Set (X × D) := {p | p.2 = d₀}
  let V : Set (X × D) := {p | p.2 = d₁}
  have hU : IsOpen U := (isOpen_discrete ({d₀} : Set D)).preimage continuous_snd
  have hV : IsOpen V := (isOpen_discrete ({d₁} : Set D)).preimage continuous_snd
  have hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ := by
    ext p
    exact iff_true_intro (hD p.2)
  have hdisj : Disjoint U V := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro p hp hq
    exact hne (hp.symm.trans hq)
  letI := singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction_isIso_of_disjoint
    (TopCat.of (X × D)) U V hU hV hcover hdisj n
  exact asIso (singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction (TopCat.of (X × D)) U V n) ≪≫
    biprod.mapIso
      (simplicialCohomologyIso (TopCat.toSSet.mapIso
        (TopCat.isoOfHomeo (discreteProductFiberHomeomorph X D d₀).symm)) n)
      (simplicialCohomologyIso (TopCat.toSSet.mapIso
        (TopCat.isoOfHomeo (discreteProductFiberHomeomorph X D d₁).symm)) n)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem discreteProductCohomologyIso_hom_fst (X D : TopCat) [DiscreteTopology D]
    (d₀ d₁ : D) (hne : d₀ ≠ d₁) (hD : ∀ d : D, d = d₀ ∨ d = d₁) (n : ℕ) :
    (discreteProductCohomologyIso X D d₀ d₁ hne hD n).hom ≫ biprod.fst =
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback (discreteProductSection X D d₀)) n := by
  simp only [discreteProductCohomologyIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,
    biprod.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc, biprod.map_fst,
    singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction, biprod.lift_fst_assoc]
  change homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n ≫
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n =
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n
  rw [← homologyMap_comp, ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem discreteProductCohomologyIso_hom_snd (X D : TopCat) [DiscreteTopology D]
    (d₀ d₁ : D) (hne : d₀ ≠ d₁) (hD : ∀ d : D, d = d₀ ∨ d = d₁) (n : ℕ) :
    (discreteProductCohomologyIso X D d₀ d₁ hne hD n).hom ≫ biprod.snd =
      homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback (discreteProductSection X D d₁)) n := by
  simp only [discreteProductCohomologyIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,
    biprod.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc, biprod.map_snd,
    singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction, biprod.lift_snd_assoc]
  change homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n ≫
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n =
    homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n
  rw [← homologyMap_comp, ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

/-- Pullback from the first factor restricts to the same class on both fibers. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem discreteProductProjection_cohomology_diagonal
    (X D : TopCat) [DiscreteTopology D]
    (d₀ d₁ : D) (hne : d₀ ≠ d₁) (hD : ∀ d : D, d = d₀ ∨ d = d₁) (n : ℕ) :
    homologyMap (integralSingularCochainPullback (discreteProductProjection X D)) n ≫
      (discreteProductCohomologyIso X D d₀ d₁ hne hD n).hom = biprod.lift (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) := by
  apply biprod.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, discreteProductCohomologyIso_hom_fst, biprod.lift_fst]
    change homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n ≫
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n = 𝟙 _
    rw [← homologyMap_comp, ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← Functor.map_comp,
      discreteProductSection_projection, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
      integralSimplicialCochainPullback_id,
      homologyMap_id]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, discreteProductCohomologyIso_hom_snd, biprod.lift_snd]
    change homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n ≫
      homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map _)) n = 𝟙 _
    rw [← homologyMap_comp, ← integralSimplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← Functor.map_comp,
      discreteProductSection_projection, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
      integralSimplicialCochainPullback_id,
      homologyMap_id]

/-- The canonical two-copy decomposition for a Boolean discrete factor. -/
def discreteProductBoolCohomologyIso (X : TopCat) (n : ℕ) :
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (X × Bool)) n ≅
      IntegralSingularCohomology X n ⊞ IntegralSingularCohomology X n :=
  discreteProductCohomologyIso X (TopCat.of Bool) false true (by decide)
    (by intro b; cases b <;> simp) n

end Mumford.Analytic
